incident-bot: :rotating_light: AutoPage fired for inference-gateway: elevated 5xx rate (eu-west1). Metric spike: 12 errors/min over 5m window. PD incident: INC-1766774310. Sample 5xx: 502 (upstream reset), 504 (timeout). Affected route: /v1/generate (heavy tail).
Kira W: acked and on it. picking this up now — thanks. anyone seeing obvious deploys? :eyes:
Samir: no deploys in the last 30m from deploy-bot. Looking at grafana: error-rate concentrated on nodes serving long-tail customers (seq len > 1024).
Jin: seeing repeated header parsing failures in the proxy logs for a subset of requests, looks like malformed `Host` header becomes `--` and triggers 502 from the edge. posting grep samples:
Jin: ```
[edge-proxy] 2026-03-15T02:45:12Z ERROR req_id=abc123 parse_host: invalid header: "Host:\x00example.com" -> upstream reset
[edge-proxy] 2026-03-15T02:45:14Z ERROR req_id=def456 upstream: 502
```
Samir: That matches a small subset but it's spiking at scale. Could be an external traffic fuzzing event or a client bug; impact: ~7% of requests for top-100 customers, but 28% error-rate on the long-tail route.
Kira W: ok, mitigation plan: 1) mute noisy alert to stop autopage spam, 2) apply routing rule to send long-tail traffic to a safer pool, 3) scale edge-proxies + enable strict header validation to drop malformed traffic earlier. Any objections?
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: INC-1766774310 acknowledged by Kira W. Escalation: assigned to Samir (primary) and Jin (secondary). Notifying SRE rotation.
Samir: starting with mute for alert channel `autopage-inference` to avoid duplicate pages. Command: `./opsctl pager mute --alert autopage-inference --duration 30m --reason "investigating spike"`
Kira W: I'll push a quick routing rule to route requests with seq_len > 1024 to dedicated warm pool (fast rollback ready). Applying now.
Jin: putting up nginx filter to reject invalid Host header patterns (drop, don't proxy). snippet: ```map $http_host $badhost { default 0; ~"\x00" 1; } if ($badhost) { return 400; }```
Samir: scaling edge-proxy pool by +20% in eu-west1 to buy time: `k scale deployment edge-proxy --replicas=18 -n infra-eu-west1`
incident-bot: action log: mute applied by Samir; routing policy updated by Kira W; proxy filter rolled by Jin; scaling started.
Kira W: quick customer-impact check: running query against request logs -> approx 4.5k failed requests in last 10m, ~1.2k unique customer tokens, highest impact on 3 customers (they see degraded latencies). Will coordinate customer comms if this persists.
Samir: traffic diverted to warm pool, p50 latency stable, error-rate for /v1/generate dropped from 22% -> 9% after routing, still above baseline. continuing analysis.
Jin: proxy errors from malformed hosts have dropped to near-zero after filter. Most remaining 5xx are upstream timeouts on large seq requests — likely overloaded KV cache or backend model hosts.
Kira W: next: spin an ad-hoc kv-cache warmup for warm pool and ramp capacity: `./infra-ops warmup --pool warm-eu --target 80%`
Samir: warmup done, cache hit rate improving; error-rate down to 3% over last 3m.
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: INC-1766774310 resolved (status changed to acknowledged -> resolved) by Samir.
Kira W: excellent. I'm going to handoff to SRE rotation for post-incident review and writeup. Main action items: (1) implement upstream header sanitization in the edge codebase, (2) add a rule to route long-sequence requests to a dedicated, autoscaled pool by default, (3) create an alert that correlates malformed-header logs + 5xx to avoid blind pages.
Samir: +1 on followups. Noting runbook improvement: check header-parsing regressions after any proxy change.
Jin: leaving a note to add unit tests for `parse_host()` and more aggressive log sampling for malformed headers.
Kira W: final customer-impact note: three mid-tier customers saw elevated error rates for ~18m; will initiate outreach via success team. Closing thread here, will add postmortem link when available. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: thread closed.
